en.headline: Special traffic arrangements for Victoria Harbour Race in Wan Chai and Tsim Sha Tsui
en.dek: The Transport Department said Expo Drive East will close on Sunday and several ferry and water taxi services will be suspended from Saturday to support the November 15 race.
body: The Transport Department announced special traffic and transport arrangements in Wan Chai North and Tsim Sha Tsui for the Victoria Harbour Race 2026, scheduled for Sunday, November 15.

A section of Expo Drive East outside Golden Bauhinia Square, including the pick-up and drop-off area north of its junction with Expo Drive, will be temporarily closed from 12.30am to about 1pm on November 15. Landing steps at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai and at Kowloon Public Pier Nos. 1 to 4 will close in phases from 9am on November 14 until about 1pm on November 15.

Because of the pier closures, the water taxi route between Tsim Sha Tsui East and Central via West Kowloon and Wan Chai will be suspended for the whole of November 14, and three sailings from Tsim Sha Tsui East will be cancelled on November 15. Ferry services between Wan Chai and Tsim Sha Tsui will stop from the first sailing until 11am on November 15, while services between Central and Hung Hom will stop until 11.10am.

Cross-harbour bus route 961 will relocate its Expo Drive East terminus to Harbour Road outside Wan Chai Swimming Pool from the first departure until 1pm on November 15. The Citybus H3 stop near Golden Bauhinia Square will also be suspended during the same period. Services are expected to resume once the affected harbour areas reopen.

zh.headline: 維港泳周日舉行 灣仔北及尖沙咀實施特別交通安排
zh.dek: 運輸署表示，金紫荊廣場外一段博覽道東周日臨時封閉，多條渡輪及水上的士航線周六日起暫停服務。
body: 運輸署公布，為配合11月15日星期日舉行的維港泳2026，灣仔北及尖沙咀將實施特別交通及運輸安排。
金紫荊廣場外、博覽道交界以北的一段博覽道東（包括上落客區）將於11月15日凌晨零時30分至下午約1時臨時封閉。灣仔香港會議展覽中心梯台及九龍公眾碼頭第1號至第4號登岸梯級，則由11月14日上午9時起至11月15日下午約1時分階段封閉。
因登岸設施封閉，來往尖東至中環（經西九龍及灣仔）的水上的士將於11月14日全日暫停，11月15日亦有三班由尖東開出的班次取消。來往灣仔至尖沙咀的渡輪將於11月15日由首班船起至上午11時暫停；來往中環至紅磡的渡輪則暫停至上午11時10分。
過海巴士第961號線位於博覽道東的終點站，將於11月15日首班車至下午1時遷往港灣道灣仔游泳池外。城巴第H3號線近金紫荊廣場的巴士站同期暫停使用。水上的士及渡輪服務將視乎受影響海港範圍實際重開時間恢復。
